name: speaker-notes
body: A `# notes` section holds speaker notes, rendered via the embedded reveal.js notes plugin (`dist/plugin/notes.js`). A `# notes` section belongs to a slide file's top level; declaring it inside a section template is an error. At most one `# notes` section per slide, and it is the last section on the slide; a second `# notes` is an error, and any section after a `# notes` is an error. It does not count toward any section's min/max repeat limits. `notes` is reserved and unavailable as a template section name (requirements.constraint.reserved-template-names). Notes body follows the Markdown subset.
